dct_title_s: Improvement plan of Glenwood-Camden Parkway, drawing no. 1, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: Drawing number one of an improvement plan for Glenwood-Camden Parkway in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-fourth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 40.
